result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visual defect is a missing/failed restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section, where a grey placeholder with a broken-image icon appears instead of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar photo. No other clear breakage is visible.

issues.description: The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card in 'Popular right now' shows a blank grey area with a broken-image icon instead of a restaurant photo, unlike the other restaurant cards which display images.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for this restaurant or provide a proper fallback image (e.g., a branded placeholder or cuisine-type illustration) so the card does not appear broken.
